Without the comma, 紹興五年 and 英州 fuse into one place-name; Shaoxing is the reign and Yingzhou the prefecture.

Zhang Wenrao, Commissioner of Judicial Review for the Chengdu Circuit, suspected Yang of having a secret affair and, fearing exposure, of killing Yi to silence him; he ordered Shiquan Army to investigate.
The original makes Zhang the killer; 疑楊有私，懼為人知，殺乙以滅口 is Zhang's suspicion that Yang killed Yi to hide an affair.

The investigating official Li Zhining doubted the case; that evening he dressed in full regalia and prayed to Heaven.

Zhining reflected on the dream: "Is not the killer surnamed Yuan?"

將樂縣宰黃垺 is Huang Fou; Kun is not a reading of 垺.
